programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout

programme.title: Funny Pages

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: (2006) Spooky animated caper with Maggie Gyllenhaal and Steve Buscemi. A young boy and his babysitter spy on the creepy neighbour. Did he really eat his wife?

programme.title: Miracle on 34th Street
programme.desc: (1994) Festive family drama. Richard Attenborough stars as a department store Santa who insists he's the real Santa Claus. But can he prove it in court?

programme.title: The Devil Wears Prada
programme.desc: (2006) Comedy-drama starring Anne Hathaway and Meryl Streep. A naive young woman lands a job as assistant to one of New York's most important, but ruthless and cynical, magazine editors.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: (2004) All-action thriller. Queen Latifah stars as the driver of the fastest taxi in New York, who teams up with an inept cop (Jimmy Fallon) to catch a team of female bank-robbers.

programme.title: See How They Run
programme.desc: (2022) Sam Rockwell and Saoirse Ronan head a splendid ensemble for this comedy whodunnit that places a real murder among a production of Agatha Christie's The Mousetrap. With Adrien Brody.

programme.title: Last Night in Soho
programme.desc: (2021) Edgar Wright's horror with Thomasin McKenzie, Anya Taylor-Joy and Matt Smith. A fashion student's transported back to Swinging-60s London. But nostalgia's not what it used to be...

programme.title: The Entity
programme.desc: (1982) Sidney J Furie's seminal horror stars Barbara Hershey as a divorced mother of three who becomes the victim of a poltergeist that submits her to multiple violent and sexual assaults.

programme.title: Deck the Halls
programme.desc: (2006) Comedy. Neighbours Matthew Broderick and Danny DeVito get extremely competitive as they festoon their houses with increasingly outrageous festive decorations and lights.

programme.title: The Black Swan
programme.desc: (1942) Swashbuckling adventure with Laird Cregar and Tyrone Power. Privateer Captain Henry Morgan tries to rid the Caribbean of pirates when he's made Governor of Jamaica. Bit rich.

programme.title: Little Women
programme.desc: (2019) Greta Gerwig's Oscar-winning period drama adaptation of the classic Louisa May Alcott novel, starring Emma Watson, Saoirse Ronan, Florence Pugh, Timothée Chalamet and Meryl Streep.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle

programme.title: Man V. Food

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Ten passionate home bakers take part in a bake-off to test every aspect of their baking skills as they battle to be crowned the Great British Bake Off's best amateur baker. S1, Ep1

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The eight home bakers who made it through the first round are taken to Scone Palace near Perth in Scotland to make biscuits and teatime treats. Two more bakers will be eliminated. S1, Ep2

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The six remaining bakers are challenged to make bread. Which of them will best cope with the pressure and who will be the one who has to leave the Bake Off? S1, Ep3

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The remaining bakers must reinvent an often-neglected British classic - the pudding. Judges Paul Hollywood and Mary Berry tests the contestants ability to cope with pressure. S1, Ep4

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The remaining bakers make their own versions of hearty British pies. Then judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood will decide who will be the final three to go through to the final. S1, Ep5

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: It is the Grand Final and the three surviving contestants must bake for the afternoon tea party. Who will be crowned the Great British Bake Off's Best Amateur Baker? S1, Ep6

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Cake. The 12 new bakers don their aprons and head for the iconic tent for cake week, starting with the signature challenge, to make the well-loved Madeira cake. S6, Ep1

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Biscuits. The remaining home bakers try to prove their skill at making 24 biscotti, and they tackle labour-intensive Arlettes in a tricky technical challenge. S6, Ep2

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Bread. The bakers must prepare quick breads with no proving, and a deceptively simple baguette - will they impress Paul Hollywood? Plus, showstopping action with 3D bread sculptures. S6, Ep3

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Desserts. The nine remaining bakers tackle creme brulee but will they be a scrambled mess? Plus, Spanische windtorte from Austria and baked cheesecake feature in the show-stopper. S6, Ep4

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Alternative Ingredients. The bakers must bake without sugar, gluten or dairy - but thankfully not all in the same challenge. Plus, things get sticky in Paul's technical challenge. S6, Ep5

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Pastry. It's time for the bakers to prove their pastry skills, and the technical challenge has them all treading carefully as they tackle the delicate world of puff pastry. S6, Ep6

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Victorian. Mary dusts off her antique cookbooks to find a technical recipe that dates back to the late 1800s, in an episode devoted entirely to the baking landscape of the Victorian era. S6, Ep7

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Patisserie. It's the quarter-finals, and the five remaining bakers work their way through childhood favourites and delicate French fancies to a mountainous choux pastry masterpiece. S6, Ep8

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Chocolate. Week nine, and that can only mean one thing, it's the semi-finals. The pressure is on as the bakers get to grips with one of the most difficult ingredients - chocolate. S6, Ep9

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The Final. It's the final, and Mary and Paul are expecting nothing short of perfection. Who will hold their nerve and be crowned winner of this year's Great British Bake Off? S6, Ep10
